mapper.select: WITH my_club AS ( SELECT DISTINCT my_p.clubOwner_Key FROM clubjoin my_cj JOIN player my_p ON my_p.clubJoin_Num = my_cj.clubJoin_Num WHERE my_cj.memberIdx = #{memberIdx} ) SELECT cj.memberIdx, p.clubJoin_Num AS clubJoinNum, p.position, p.uniform_No AS uniformNo, p.height, p.weight, TO_CHAR(p.join_Date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS joinDate, p.clubOwner_Key AS clubOwnerKey, c.club_Name AS clubName, p.status, m1.userName, m2.profile_photo FROM player p JOIN club c ON c.clubOwner_Key = p.clubOwner_Key JOIN my_club mc ON mc.clubOwner_Key = p.clubOwner_Key JOIN clubjoin cj ON cj.clubJoin_Num = p.clubJoin_Num JOIN member1 m1 ON m1.memberIdx = cj.memberIdx LEFT OUTER JOIN member2 m2 ON m2.memberIdx = cj.memberIdx
